explication: Crucix is a self-hosted OSINT intelligence terminal. Its main workflow is a scheduled sweep of public feeds, synthesis into dashboard-ready cross-domain signals, change detection and optional idea/alert generation, then live delivery to browsers and messaging bots. The map preserves the documented dashboard capabilities as part of synthesis; source excerpts do not show every adapter or all alert/LLM wiring, so uncertain internal links are omitted.
